title: hyptis nervosa var. candida
intro: Hyptis nervosa var. candida, commonly known as White Hyptis or Mexican Tea, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family, native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is valued for its traditional use in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, alleviating stress, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of White Hyptis are attributed to its ability to interact with the nervous system, providing sedative and anxiolytic effects, and its anti-inflammatory properties are believed to be responsible for its analgesic and antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents of Hyptis nervosa var. candida include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
